text: CHIEF EXACT-SOURCE AMEND on cand-4XJ36RFAA71YCG7FKTETTBDZKY / a674e1468031544868721e7459c8e11120b13659. Parent/base/path/diff-check are clean, and the successor substantively closes the four prior bypasses. Three internally linked repairs remain. (1) Lines 71-84 misstate current source: SemanticDistance.apply returns Estimate[Double], not an Either/Left. Estimate.toOption keeps Observed(v) including an observed non-finite v and drops only Missing(reason). Thus valid finite does not arrive as None, observed non-finite currently survives, and typed MissingReason is erased by candidate generation. Rewrite the attempt ledger from those exact constructors; name any future provider/derivation execution failure separately rather than attributing it to a nonexistent Left. Add a source mutation for each current branch. (2) Lines 130-133 still allow deterministic lexical work to carry a typed no-provider-execution value, contradicting lines 146 and 285-288, which correctly settle that lexical nomination gets a local derivation receipt. Remove the permissive alternative. (3) Lines 180-183 call the union of every non-admitting outcome Abstention. That launders provider abstention, missing evidence, malformed/non-finite output, and execution failure into one status even though M6 says they remain distinct. Derive a separately named no-admitted-ranking/unrankable aggregate for GraphHsmm; reserve ProviderAbstained for the typed attempt outcome; retain exact reason composition in the bundle; keep ablation-empty separate. Add a mutation where all attempts fail rather than abstain and require Unranked/no-ranking without a fabricated provider-abstention claim. One-doc successor only; no API or implementation. This is a chief source hold before formal review, not authorization.
